description: Remove a tracking domain. From now on emails that used it take another of your tracking domains in use, or go out without the open pixel and tracked links when none is left. Opens and clicks already recorded stay. Links in emails already sent keep working for 365 days after each email went out, as long as the DNS record stays: the name's certificate keeps renewing for that long. Delete the record to stop them sooner.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: remove_tracking_domain
